def test_extract_json_recovers_complete_action_before_extra_brace_and_fence(self):
        raw = (
            '{\n'
            '    "action": "tool",\n'
            '    "status": "Prüfe PHP-Syntax aller geänderten Dateien",\n'
            '    "tool": "shell",\n'
            '    "args": {\n'
            '        "command": "find . -name \'*.php\' -path \'./inc/ansichten/wartungsfenster/*\' -exec php -l\n'
            '{} \\\\;"\n'
            '    }\n'
            '}\n'
            '}\n'
            '```'
        )
        parsed = AgentController._extract_json(raw)
        self.assertEqual(parsed["action"], "tool")
        self.assertEqual(parsed["tool"], "shell")
        self.assertIn("php -l", parsed["args"]["command"])
        self.assertIn("{} \\;", parsed["args"]["command"])
